Intrux Code Search

Intrux Code Search extends and unlocks ServiceNow's out-of-the-box code search capabilities, providing fast, comprehensive, and non-blocking search across your entire instance.

Key Features

  • Universal Code Search$[SP]across scripts, configurations, and metadata
  • Flow Designer$[SP]and$[SP]UI Builder$[SP]support
  • Automatic coverage$[SP]for newly created tables and fields
  • Non-blocking code search running in$[SP]background
  • Optional$[SP]fix$[SP]for Classic Studio Code Search limitations
